_what_is_measured: rho = r(leg B) / r(leg A), both per-step wall rates from ExecutionTime deltas WITHIN ONE RUN. Leg A: 40 steps, deltaT 0.02, t 0 -> 0.8 -- the window every C4/C5 wall factor was measured on. Leg B: 400 steps, deltaT 0.1, startFrom latestTime, t 0.8 -> 40.8 -- a BOUNDED sample of the ladder's soak regime. The predecessor T25R6b was withdrawn because its instrument ran 400 steps at deltaT 0.02 and so contained only 29.7 % of the bias it existed to bound: a ladder run is 3500 leg-A steps at deltaT 0.02 plus 8300 leg-B steps at deltaT 0.1, and 70.3 % of ladder steps are leg-B steps at the 5x larger timestep.
_why_the_legs_are_independent: r(leg A) and r(leg B) are means over DISJOINT sets of ExecutionTime deltas, parsed from TWO SEPARATE FILES written by TWO SEPARATE mpirun invocations, each starting its own ExecutionTime clock at zero. Neither number is computed from the other; no term appears in both but ranks and the constant 60, which cancel in the ratio. Nothing in the grader divides one leg's number by the other's to obtain a third and then offers the third back as corroboration -- which is exactly what the predecessor's 'two independent routes' cost basis did. WHAT WOULD BREAK IT: (a) THE SHARED BOX -- if per-core throughput differs between the two windows, rho absorbs contention as if it were the deltaT regime change; /proc/loadavg is witnessed before leg A, between the legs and after leg B and is REPORTED beside rho, and a witness is not a control; (b) THE RESTART COUPLING -- leg B starts latestTime from leg A's output, so its first steps carry field re-read and matrix re-assembly cost, which G-T6c-1 (evaluated FIRST) exists to catch; (c) THE SHARED PARSER -- one instrument reads both legs, and its defects cancel in the ratio only if multiplicative and identical across them, so the planted-zero control is planted into BOTH leg logs.
_default_deny_order: 1 planted-zero control on the ExecutionTime reader, BOTH legs (rule 3) -- failure is a REFUSAL, exit 2, and issues NO verdict at all; 2 rule 4 completion, all conjuncts, both legs, AGE GUARD vs 0/module/T -- failure is NOT A RESULT, exit 4; 3 G-T6c-1 PLATEAU, evaluated BEFORE rho is consulted -- failure is NOT A RESULT with rho printed beside it and NOT graded; 4 G-T6c-2 DIRECTION -- rho < 1.0 is PASS, rho >= 1.0 is GATE FAIL. THE COMPARATOR REFUSES RATHER THAN DEGRADES.
_planted_zero_is_sized_to_the_instrument: PLANT_S = 1.23 s at step 7, NOT the T3 constant 1.234e-03. OpenFOAM prints ExecutionTime to TWO DECIMALS, so 0.01 s is the smallest perturbation this log can represent; a 1.234e-03 plant would be ANNIHILATED by the print format and the control would 'pass' by reading a zero it was never able to read. The plant is added to the cumulative value at step 7 AND EVERY STEP AFTER, so it lands in EXACTLY ONE DELTA, and the control requires that delta to rise by exactly PLANT_S AND NO OTHER DELTA TO MOVE -- a control on a STEP, never a maximum or a total over all steps (the defect VERIFICATION_CHARTER 2d.11.1 found in the T3 control). Tolerance 1e-6 x max(|E[i]|, |E[i-1]|, PLANT_S), RELATIVE TO THE OPERANDS DIFFERENCED, never a bare absolute below the arithmetic noise floor.
_age_guard_region_is_module: THE DATING FILE IS 0/module/T, NOT 0/T. This family is chtMultiRegionFoam and the region is `module`; a comparator asserting 0/T here would assert A FILE THAT DOES NOT EXIST, the age guard would never evaluate, and it would never say so. run_one_t25R6c.sh creates 0/ from 0.orig at launch and touches 0/module/T LAST, then verifies it exists (exit 95). It REFUSES if 0/ already exists (exit 92) or if any numeric time directory does (exit 93); both refusals were exercised on a scratch case before filing, along with exit 89 (no case dir). The stager is FORBIDDEN to create 0/ and asserts its own absence afterwards -- a stager that pre-created 0/ would make rule 4's age guard unevaluable.

_X_T6c_struck_as_a_corroboration: THE REGISTERED CLOSED FORM, APPLIED TO THIS RUN'S OWN r(leg A), RETURNS rho IDENTICALLY BY ALGEBRA -- total = N_A*rA + N_B*rB, ratio = (N_A + N_B*rho)/(N_A + N_B), so ((N_A+N_B)*ratio - N_A)/N_B = rho for every input.
